name: Task-demand target
role: Define the computation that an actuator must realize
replaceable_by: standard task generator; real task protocol
notes: Exp30 explicit mixtures are historical; Exp31 queries one random value to remove algebraic shortcuts

name: Associative key memory
role: Store content-addressable support information
notes: Dense capacity-limited keys replace the historical one-hot exact-retrieval shortcut

name: Reward-only controller
role: Select an executed actuator from local scalar feedback
notes: A standard bandit-like controller used only in synthetic feasibility panels

name: Persistent feedback eligibility
role: Assign delayed scalar feedback to executed history
notes: Full-stream scores charge exploration and adaptation; the opposite control is not budget matched

name: Frozen visual encoder
role: Map raw frames to shared embeddings
notes: Identical frozen weights and transforms across every paired Exp34 condition

name: Support prototype memory
role: Bind each held-out user object from clean support
replaceable_by: nearest neighbour; linear head; Naive Bayes
notes: All clean frames are eligible; forbidden clean-video annotations are excluded

name: Diagonal gain motif
role: Reweight unreliable embedding coordinates
notes: Standard support-derived operator; no query quality annotation or label is available

name: Delta association motif
role: Write bounded class associations into a fast state
notes: Standard delta-memory operator; support-only writes are audited

name: Temporal accumulation motif
role: Maintain causal class evidence through clutter
input_format: current class evidence and previous state
notes: Standard EMA-like operator using only the current and earlier frames

name: Causal-prefix consistency router
role: Historical selector under audit
input_format: current operator predictions and past within-video counts
replaceable_by: prefix vote; prefix probability accumulation; calibrated stack
notes: Exp35 opposes this component as a reliability router and demonstrates stable-wrong lock-in

name: Task head
role: Decode object identity from a common class map
notes: The class map is formed from support only

name: Full-bank cost accounting
role: Charge every computed motif and controller state
output_format: event L1 state bytes and optional MACs
notes: Current Exp34 has no efficiency claim because all four motifs execute

name: High-rank E/I carrier
role: Execute selected effective currents in a participating state
notes: Separate programme component excluded from the current paper

name: Causal prefix probability accumulator
role: Aggregate class evidence over frames
input_format: current class probabilities and previous cumulative evidence
notes: Strongest Exp35 baseline; positive mechanism evidence is retrospective and the multi-operator bank value is inconclusive

name: Matched causal reliability audit
role: Separate concentration routing from temporal accumulation and stable error
input_format: frozen support query tape operator probabilities and registered interventions
output_format: user-level paired effects and failure-boundary metrics
replaceable_by: generic algorithm-selection evaluation; ordinary ablation suite
notes: Novelty is claimed only for the combined ORBIT information boundary exact stable-wrong control and evidence-governed audit; not for any individual baseline

name: Frozen high-dimensional carrier
role: Provide per-frame visual embeddings without external adaptation
notes: Same representation and evidence tape for every Exp38 condition

name: Train-only vMF evidence model
role: Convert frozen embeddings to class evidence and generative surprise
output_format: class probabilities and relative log likelihood
notes: Directions and concentration fit on support videos only; temperature fits development-fit videos

name: Three-statistic causal control state
role: Represent surprise entropy and fast/slow disagreement
notes: Normalization fits development-fit only and no deployable input uses labels or future frames

name: Continuous memory-horizon actuator
role: Map causal state to one retention and update evidence memory
input_format: three causal scalars and prior evidence state
replaceable_by: hard reset; fixed EMA; sliding window
notes: Tested without autograd BPTT or representation update; qualification reachability was not robust and no external utility claim is supported

name: Outcome-lock qualification gate
role: Require memory value adaptive headroom switch harm and reachability before external access
notes: Triggered as designed: 0/5 joint passes kept all external features and outcomes locked

name: Factorized uncertainty state
role: Separate abrupt hazard gradual process volatility and observation noise
input_format: causal innovations and prior filter state
replaceable_by: single scalar retention; fixed noise parameters
notes: Implemented as three local online-EM scalars with no future inputs autograd BPTT or test-time optimization

name: State-aware Bayesian update
role: Convert h Q and R into a predictive distribution and effective learning rate
input_format: prior mean covariance and current observation
output_format: posterior state predictive NLL and effective gain
replaceable_by: Kalman filter; HMM; directional delta update
notes: Novelty cannot rest on standard Bayesian filtering

name: Matched fixed and IMM controls
role: Provide strong alternatives using the same observations and fit split
replaceable_by: best EMA; window; fixed Kalman; STAD-style state-space filter
notes: Must beat selected fixed and four-mode seen-condition IMM; eight-mode factorial IMM and dynamic truth filter are disclosed privileged upper bounds

name: Orthogonal uncertainty generator
role: Manipulate stochasticity abrupt hazard and gradual drift independently
notes: Fit sees baseline plus isolated elevations; pairwise and triple combinations are primary held-out compositions

name: Selective state clamps
role: Test whether each factorized state has a distinct computational role
input_format: fitted h Q R state with one component clamped
notes: All three selectivity directions must be frozen before outcomes
